title: uor-q/experiment/1
description: One chaos experiment, in the shape of principlesofchaos.org: a steady-state hypothesis measured on Q's output, a real-world event to introduce, and the questions to measure it with. Its BLAKE3 kappa label (JCS, NFC) is its identity: the community approves that exact label in automation/chaos-approvals.json, so a changed experiment is a new, unapproved one.

why.description: The real-world event this stands for, and why it matters.

hypothesis.description: The steady state the experiment tries to disprove: at most this share of questions with a wrong outcome, and the 95th percentile latency at most this many seconds.

variable.description: The fault, at the network, and the share of calls it strikes, drawn from BLAKE3 of the label and the call index. For a burst: how many copies of each question arrive at once.
